request.query: For a nonzero multivariate polynomial, vanishing of all Hasse derivatives in a coordinate degree box of weight below c implies index at least c.

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_eq_zero_of_lt_natDegree
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ), p.natDegree < n → (Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) p = 0

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_hasseDeriv_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) p).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - n

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_C
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (r : R), 0 < k → (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) (Polynomial.C r) = 0

items.name: MvPolynomial.weightedTotalDegree'_eq_bot_iff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {σ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : SemilatticeSup M] (w : σ → M) (p : MvPolynomial σ R), MvPolynomial.weightedTotalDegree' w p = ⊥ ↔ p = 0

items.name: Polynomial.lt_rootMultiplicity_of_isRoot_iterate_derivative
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [CharZero R] {p : Polynomial R} {t : R} {n : ℕ},
  p ≠ 0 → (∀ m ≤ n, ((⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[m] p).IsRoot t) → n < Polynomial.rootMultiplicity t p

items.name: MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_eq_zero
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (n : ℕ) (φ : MvPolynomial σ R),
  φ.totalDegree < n → (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent n) φ = 0
